== Description ==

[[Chris Wirfs]] (left, glasses, floral/Hawaiian button shirt, name tag) and [[Ryan Jellison]] (right, grey “SUMMER LEAGUE” sweatshirt, glasses, looking at cards) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
